reviews.review: a friend gifted me this game using a steam key, too bad that means he cant get his money back lmao. its literally complete ♥♥♥♥, I feel so bad for the devs
I had high hopes, however the game is just bland and not very memorable. Very buggy with various frame rate drops as well. Honestly one of my biggest disappointments this year along with Saints Row.

reviews.review: I tried.  I really tried.  But I can't.  Do yourself a favor and dont.

I personally really enjoyed the game, though there were times were it felt as tho the enemies could have been more well balanced and it has its fair share of bugs. I would love to see more content for this game as i do feel its a breath of fresh air for the genre, straying from the typical zombie horde shooter or wave survival games, and with a compelling narrative that kept me rather intrigued. i honestly believe that this game doesn't deserve nearly as much hate as it has received

boring, full of bugs, aint worth the price, even if it was for free- i'd not recommend to play it...
it had a great potential, but reality is different.
